Enfrasys Solutions is responsible for ensuring content accuracy. ## 3.1 Microsoft Fabric Definition Microsoft Fabric is an integrated analytics platform designed to unify data engineering, data science, data integration, and business intelligence within a single cloud-based environment. It enables organizations to manage the entire data lifecycle—from ingestion to transformation, storage, and visualization—using a suite of interconnected services. The core services within Microsoft Fabric include: - **Data Factory:** Facilitates data integration and orchestration, allowing users to build, schedule, and manage Extract, Transform, Load (ETL) pipelines for diverse data sources. - **Synapse:** Provides advanced analytics and big data processing capabilities, supporting real-time and batch analytics on large datasets. - **Data Science:** Offers tools and environments for developing, training, and deploying machine learning models to extract predictive insights from data. - **OneLake:** Serves as a unified data lake storage layer, ensuring seamless data access and sharing across all Fabric services. Enfrasys Solutions recommends Universiti Malaysia Sabah implement Microsoft Fabric to streamline data workflows, enhance analytics capabilities, and support scalable machine learning processes. ## 3.2 Power BI Definition and Integration Power BI is a business analytics service by Microsoft that enables users to visualize data, share insights, and drive informed decision-making through interactive dashboards and reports. Power BI integrates natively with Microsoft Fabric, allowing seamless access to datasets stored in OneLake, and leveraging Fabric’s ETL and analytics pipelines for real-time and historical data visualization. This integration empowers Universiti Malaysia Sabah to: - Visualize transformed and cleansed data directly from Fabric workspaces. - Enable self-service analytics for business users. - Maintain a consistent, secure, and scalable analytics environment. Enfrasys Solutions will ensure that Power BI is tightly integrated with Fabric, supporting UMS’s business-aligned analytics requirements. ## 3.3 Microsoft Entra ID Definition Microsoft Entra ID (formerly Azure Active Directory) is Microsoft’s cloud-based identity and access management service. It provides authentication and authorization mechanisms for users, applications, and resources across Microsoft 365, Azure, and Microsoft Fabric environments. Key functions include: - Secure user authentication for accessing Fabric and Power BI resources. - Role-based access control (RBAC) to ensure only authorized personnel can view or manage data and analytics assets. - Centralized identity management for compliance and auditability. Enfrasys Solutions assigns responsibility for configuring and maintaining Entra ID to ensure Universiti Malaysia Sabah’s data environment remains secure and compliant. # 4.0 Network Design and Decision This section outlines the network topology, connectivity, and security controls for Universiti Malaysia Sabah’s (UMS) Microsoft Fabric deployment, including the On-Premises Data Gateway (OPDG) architecture. ## 4.1 Network Connectivity Overview Microsoft Fabric is a unified analytics platform that integrates data engineering, data science, real-time analytics, and business intelligence into a single SaaS solution. slides.title: Azure Outbound Security Rules Consideration
slides.notes:
defines the outbound network rules required to allow the On-Premises Data Gateway (OPDG) virtual machine (VM) to securely connect to Microsoft Fabric, Power BI, and related Microsoft cloud services. These rules ensure that the gateway can authenticate, communicate, and transfer data through HTTPS in compliance with Azure networking best practices.

Rule Name : Allow_OPDG_HTTPS_Services
Purpose: Enables HTTPS communication from the gateway VM to Microsoft Fabric and Power BI endpoints.
Explanation: This rule allows outbound TCP traffic on port 443 (HTTPS) from VM Private IP Addresses to essential Microsoft domains, including Fabric, Power BI, and Azure core services (e.g., *.fabric.microsoft.com, *.powerbi.com). It ensures that the gateway can send and receive data securely using SSL/TLS encryption.

Rule Name: Allow_OPDG_Authentication
Purpose: Enables authentication and identity verification with Microsoft Entra ID (formerly Azure AD).
Explanation: This rule allows outbound HTTPS traffic (TCP port 443) to identity and login domains such as login.microsoftonline.com, aadcdn.msftauth.net, and login.windows.net. It enables user sign-ins, token validation, and secure connection establishment with Microsoft cloud services.

Rule Name: Allow_OPDG_Connectivity_Test
Purpose: Supports network connectivity verification for the OPDG service.
Explanation: This rule allows outbound HTTP traffic on port 80 (TCP) to *.msftncsi.com, a Microsoft endpoint used for network connectivity status indication and troubleshooting. It ensures the VM can verify external internet access and service availability.

# UMS Power BI & Fabric Design Review # 2.0 Executive Summary This section provides a concise overview of the Universiti Malaysia Sabah (UMS) Power BI & Microsoft Fabric solution design, its purpose, and its intended audience. ## 2.1 Project Overview Universiti Malaysia Sabah (UMS) has initiated a project to modernize its data analytics capabilities by leveraging Microsoft Fabric and Power BI. The business context centers on enabling data-driven decision-making through robust data workflows, advanced analytics, and machine learning. The project scope encompasses the design and implementation of a comprehensive data workflow, including data ingestion, transformation, and visualization within Microsoft Fabric. Key objectives include: - Establishing a dedicated Microsoft Fabric workspace for UMS. - Developing end-to-end ETL pipelines to streamline data integration and orchestration. - Conducting machine learning processes to support business analytics. - Integrating Power BI for visualization and actionable insights. - Aligning UMS’s cloud adoption strategy with the latest Microsoft Fabric services, specifically Fabric Data Factory, Fabric Synapse, and Data Science components. ## 2.2 Document Purpose The Solution Design Document (SDD) serves as the authoritative blueprint for the implementation and governance of the UMS Power BI & Microsoft Fabric solution. Its intent is to: - Detail the technical architecture, workflow design, and integration points. - Provide guidance and standards for deployment, operational management, and security. - Facilitate clear communication between Universiti Malaysia Sabah and Enfrasys Solutions regarding responsibilities, timelines, and deliverables. - Act as the reference for future audits, enhancements, and operational adoption. Enfrasys Solutions is responsible for the authorship, technical accuracy, and periodic review of this SDD. Universiti Malaysia Sabah is responsible for formal sign-off and operational adoption of the recommendations and designs contained herein. ## 2.3 Document Audience The intended audience for this Solution Design Document includes: - UMS IT Department (Infrastructure, Security, Operations) - UMS Analytics Stakeholders (Business Intelligence, Data Science, Reporting) - Enfrasys Solutions Project Team (Architects, Engineers, Consultants) - UMS Executive Sponsors and Governance Committee Enfrasys Solutions will author, maintain, and review the SDD. Universiti Malaysia Sabah shall be responsible for sign-off and ensuring operational adoption in accordance with the design recommendations. # 3.0 Microsoft Fabric, Power BI, and Entra ID Overview This section provides formal definitions and roles of Microsoft Fabric, Power BI, and Microsoft Entra ID within the Universiti Malaysia Sabah (UMS) solution architecture. ## 3.1 Microsoft Fabric Microsoft Fabric is an integrated analytics platform that unifies data engineering, data science, data integration, and business intelligence under a single SaaS offering. Fabric delivers a comprehensive suite of services, including Data Factory for data integration and orchestration, Synapse for advanced analytics and big data processing, Data Science for machine learning applications, and OneLake for unified data storage. Fabric’s core services are defined as follows: | ID | Description | Workload Type | |----|-------------|---------------| | 1 | Data Factory: Enables scalable data ingestion, transformation, and orchestration workflows. | ETL/Data Integration | | 2 | Synapse: Provides analytics, big data processing, and SQL-based querying capabilities. | Data Analytics | | 3 | Data Science: Supports AutoML, machine learning model training, and deployment. | Machine Learning | | 4 | OneLake: Centralized, secure data lake storage for all Fabric workloads. | Data Storage | Within the UMS solution, Microsoft Fabric will serve as the foundational platform for data ingestion, transformation, analytics, and machine learning, supporting end-to-end business use cases and aligning with UMS’s cloud adoption strategy. Enfrasys Solutions is responsible for technology selection, integration architecture, and Fabric workspace configuration. Universiti Malaysia Sabah shall be responsible for user enablement, workspace management, and license procurement. ## 3.2 Power BI Power BI is Microsoft’s enterprise-grade business intelligence and data visualization platform. It enables organizations to transform raw data into actionable insights through interactive dashboards, reports, and analytics. Power BI integrates natively with Microsoft Fabric, allowing seamless access to data stored in OneLake and processed via Synapse and Data Factory. Power BI’s analytics and visualization capabilities include: | No. | Design Decision | Decision | |-----|-----------------|----------| | 1 | Integration with Fabric | Power BI will connect directly to Fabric workspaces for real-time analytics | | 2 | Visualization | Power BI will be used for business-aligned dashboards and reports | | 3 | Security | Access to Power BI artifacts will be governed by Entra ID conditional access policies | Enfrasys Solutions is responsible for designing Power BI integration and configuring secure access. Universiti Malaysia Sabah shall enable users, assign roles, and manage licensing for Power BI. ## 3.3 Microsoft Entra ID Microsoft Entra ID (formerly Azure Active Directory) is Microsoft’s cloud-based identity and access management service. Entra ID provides secure authentication, user identity management, and conditional access controls for cloud and SaaS applications, including Microsoft Fabric and Power BI. Key capabilities of Entra ID include: | Capability | Description | |------------|-------------| | Authentication | Provides secure sign-in for users and applications | | Identity Management | Manages user accounts, groups, and roles | | Conditional Access | Enforces access policies based on user, device, and location | | Integration | Enables SSO and role-based access across Microsoft Fabric and Power BI | Enfrasys Solutions is responsible for designing and implementing Entra ID integration, including conditional access policies and role mapping. Universiti Malaysia Sabah shall manage user provisioning, role assignment, and license administration. # 4.0 Network Design and Decision This section outlines the network architecture and connectivity strategy for Universiti Malaysia Sabah (UMS), including the rationale for design choices and gateway deployment. ## 4.1 Network Connectivity Overview Enfrasys Solutions recommends a hybrid network topology that securely connects UMS’s on-premises environment to Microsoft Fabric and related Microsoft cloud services. The architecture leverages outbound connectivity from the on-premises network to Azure, utilizing the On-Premises Data Gateway (OPDG) for secure data transfer. Universiti Malaysia Sabah shall implement outbound-only connectivity from its data center to Azure, avoiding inbound connections to minimize security risks. Private Link is not adopted at this stage due to licensing constraints, eligibility limitations, and the complexity of configuration for UMS’s current Microsoft Entra ID tenant. Enfrasys Solutions will revisit Private Link integration in future phases if UMS upgrades its tenant or acquires suitable licenses. The network design ensures that all data transfers and authentication requests are performed over encrypted channels (HTTPS), with outbound firewall rules enforced to restrict traffic to essential Microsoft endpoints. ## 4.2 Fabric Data Gateway Architecture Microsoft Fabric is a unified analytics platform that provides data integration, transformation, and visualization capabilities across Microsoft services such as Power BI, Azure Data Explorer, and OneLake. The On-Premises Data Gateway (OPDG) is a Microsoft component that enables secure, outbound connectivity between on-premises data sources and Microsoft Fabric, allowing cloud services to access local data without exposing inbound ports. Enfrasys Solutions is responsible for designing the network architecture and deploying the OPDG virtual machine. Universiti Malaysia Sabah is responsible for preparing on-premises prerequisites, including the provisioning of the VM, installation of the required OS and .NET Framework, and configuring local firewall policies. ![](images\slide_011_img_004.png) Figure 1: OPDG architecture connecting on-premises SQL Server to Microsoft Fabric. ### VM Specifications for OPDG | Component | Specification | |-------------------|-----------------------------------------------| | Operating System | Windows 10 (64-bit) or Windows Server 2019 | | .NET Framework | Version 4.8 | | vCPU | 8 cores | | RAM | Minimum 8 GB | ### Outbound Connectivity Rules | Name | Priority | Source | Source Ports | Destination | Destination Ports | Protocol | Access | |-------------------------|----------|-----------------------|--------------|----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|-------------------|----------|--------| | Allow_OPDG_HTTPS_Services | 130 | VM Private IP Addresses | * | *.servicebus.windows.net, *.download.microsoft.com, *.core.windows.net, *.frontend.clouddatahub.net, *.dfs.fabric.microsoft.com, *.datawarehouse.fabric.microsoft.com, *.powerbi.com, *.analysis.windows.net | 443 | TCP | Allow | | Allow_OPDG_Authentication | 140 | VM Private IP Addresses | * | *.login.windows.net, login.microsoftonline.com, aadcdn.msauth.net, aadcdn.msftauth.net, *.microsoftonline-p.com, login.live.com | 443 | TCP | Allow | | Allow_OPDG_Connectivity_Test | 160 | VM Private IP Addresses | * | *.msftncsi.com | 80 | TCP | Allow | ## 4.3 Responsibility Assignment | Item | Activities | Action By | Status | |-----------------------------|------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|--------------------------|-------------| | OPDG VM Provisioning | Prepare VM with required OS, .NET, CPU, and RAM | Universiti Malaysia Sabah| Pending | | Network Architecture Design | Define topology, configure outbound rules, and document connectivity | Enfrasys Solutions | In Progress | | OPDG Deployment | Install gateway agent, validate connectivity to Microsoft Fabric | Enfrasys Solutions | Pending | | Firewall Configuration | Implement outbound NSG/firewall rules as per table above | Universiti Malaysia Sabah| Pending | ## 4.4 Design Decisions | No. | Design Decision | Decision | |-----|-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|----------------------------------------------| | DD01| Outbound-only connectivity for OPDG VM, no inbound ports exposed | Approved | | DD02| Private Link not implemented due to licensing and tenant eligibility constraints | Deferred to future phase | | DD03| OPDG VM deployed with minimum 8 vCPU, 8 GB RAM, Windows Server 2019/Windows 10, .NET Framework 4.8 | Approved | | DD04| Outbound firewall rules enforced to restrict traffic to Microsoft endpoints only | Approved | # 5.0 Roles in Microsoft Fabric This section defines the roles, responsibilities, and access assignments for Universiti Malaysia Sabah (UMS) within the Microsoft Fabric platform. ## 5.1 Fabric Administrator Role Microsoft Fabric is an integrated analytics platform that combines data engineering, data science, real-time analytics, and business intelligence into a unified SaaS experience. It enables organizations to manage data workflows, build analytics solutions, and govern access efficiently. The Fabric Administrator, also referred to as the Data Engineer, is responsible for overseeing the configuration, management, and governance of the Fabric environment. Responsibilities include: - Managing workspace creation and lifecycle - Assigning and revoking user roles and permissions - Monitoring data pipeline health and resource utilization - Ensuring compliance with Universiti Malaysia Sabah (UMS) data governance policies - Troubleshooting and resolving operational issues Fabric Administrators possess the highest level of permissions within the workspace, enabling them to perform all administrative actions, including role assignments, resource provisioning, and security configuration. ## 5.2 Fabric-native Roles Microsoft Fabric provides several native roles to facilitate granular access control within workspaces. The primary roles are: | Permission | Admin | Contributor | Member | Viewer | |------------|-------|-------------|--------|--------| | Create, edit, delete workspace content | ✅ | ✅ | ❌ | ❌ | | Assign roles and permissions | ✅ | ❌ | ❌ | ❌ | | View workspace content | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | | Publish datasets and reports | ✅ | ✅ | ❌ | ❌ | | Manage workspace settings | ✅ | ❌ | ❌ | ❌ | - **Admin**: Full control over workspace, including management of resources and user roles. - **Contributor**: Can create and modify content but cannot manage workspace settings or assign roles. - **Member**: Can view content and participate in collaborative activities. - **Viewer**: Read-only access to workspace content. ## 5.3 UMS Workspace Role and Access Enfrasys Solutions is responsible for initial mapping and assignment of workspace roles to UMS personnel based on operational requirements. Universiti Malaysia Sabah (UMS) shall manage ongoing role adjustments, ensuring that access aligns with organizational changes and project needs. | No. | Workspace Role | Suggested Role | UMS PIC | |-----|---------------------|-------------------------------|----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------| | 1 | Workspace Admin | Fabric Admin / Data Engineer | Dr Suraya Binti Alias

It leverages OneLake as a central data lake, supports ETL pipelines, lakehouse layering, and enables seamless integration with Power BI for visualization. Enfrasys Solutions recommends the following data workflow considerations for UMS, covering the entire pipeline from data ingestion to visualization: | ID | Description | Workload Type | |------|---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|--------------------| | DC01 | Data Pipeline will be used to ingest data from Microsoft SQL Server. | Data Factory | | DC02 | The Bronze Lakehouse will store raw/original data ingested from Microsoft SQL Server. | Data Engineering | | DC03 | The Silver Lakehouse will store cleansed data sourced from the bronze Lakehouse. | Data Engineering | | DC04 | The Gold Lakehouse will store transformed data sourced from the silver Lakehouse. | Data Engineering | | DC05 | Data cleansing and transformation for the Silver Lakehouse will be performed using Dataflow Gen2, Notebook and Visual Query in the SQL Analytics Endpoint. | Data Engineering | | DC06 | Dataflow Gen2 will be used to move data between Lakehouses (e.g., from bronze to silver or silver to gold). | Data Factory | | DC07 | AutoML from Data Science will be used to demonstrate the Machine Learning Process, and the results will be stored in Gold Lakehouse | Data Science | | DC08 | Data modeling will be implemented in the Semantic Model, using data from the Gold Lakehouse. | Power BI | | DC09 | Power BI Desktop will connect to the Semantic Model via OneLake for data visualization. | Power BI | ![](images\slide_009_img_003.png) Figure 1: End-to-end data workflow architecture. ## 6.2 Data Workflow Design Decisions Enfrasys Solutions recommends the following design decisions for UMS’s ETL, lakehouse layering, and ML integration: | No. | Design Decision | Decision | |-----|----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------| | 1 | ETL Pipeline Tool | Azure Data Factory and Dataflow Gen2 for orchestrating data ingestion and movement. | | 2 | Lakehouse Layering | Bronze (raw), Silver (cleansed), Gold (transformed) layers for structured data processing.| | 3 | Cleansing and Transformation | Dataflow Gen2, Notebooks, Visual Query in SQL Analytics Endpoint for Silver layer. | | 4 | ML Integration | Manual ML via Fabric Notebooks (PySpark/Python) and AutoML for model training and scoring.| | 5 | Model Registry | Use Fabric Model Registry for lifecycle management and versioning of trained models. | | 6 | Output Storage | Store scored ML outputs and performance metrics in Gold Lakehouse. | | 7 | Data Modeling | Semantic Model connects to Gold Lakehouse via Direct Lake (OneLake). | | 8 | Visualization | Power BI Desktop connects to Semantic Model via OneLake for reporting and analytics. | ![](images\slide_021_img_005.png) Figure 2: Machine Learning workflow within Fabric. ## 6.3 Access Design Considerations and Decisions ### Conditional Access Conditional Access in Microsoft Fabric is a security feature that enables organizations to enforce access policies based on user identity, device compliance, location, and risk signals. Enfrasys Solutions recommends UMS implement Conditional Access policies to safeguard sensitive data and ensure compliance. | No. | Policy | Decision | |-----|--------------------------------------------|------------------------------------------------| | 1 | Conditional Access for Fabric and Power BI | Enforce policy for all privileged and data access users. | **Rationale:** Conditional Access ensures only compliant, authenticated users access critical data resources, reducing risk of unauthorized access. ### Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) is a security mechanism requiring users to provide two or more verification methods before accessing resources. Enfrasys Solutions strongly recommends UMS enforce MFA for all Fabric and Power BI users. | No. | Policy | Decision | |-----|-------------------------|--------------------------| | 1 | MFA Enforcement | Mandatory for all users. | **Rationale:** MFA significantly reduces the risk of account compromise and is a best practice for protecting sensitive analytics and reporting environments. ### Direct User Access Direct user access refers to users connecting to Fabric workspaces, lakehouses, and Power BI reports. Enfrasys Solutions recommends UMS restrict direct access to authorized personnel only and use role-based access control (RBAC). | No. | Policy | Decision | |-----|--------------------------|--------------------------| | 1 | RBAC for Workspace Access| Assign roles based on job function and least privilege principle. | **Rationale:** RBAC ensures that users have only the permissions necessary for their responsibilities, minimizing risk and maintaining data integrity. ## 6.4 Virtual Machine (VM) Size The OPDG VM specification for UMS is as follows: | Component | Specification | |------------------|--------------------------------------------| | Operating System | Windows 10 (64-bit) or Windows Server 2019 (64-bit) | | .NET Framework | Version 4.8 | | vCPU | 8 cores | | RAM | Minimum 8 GB | ## 6.5 Resource Organization Design ### Management Groups Management Groups in Azure provide a logical hierarchy for organizing subscriptions and resources. Enfrasys Solutions recommends UMS use Management Groups to separate environments (e.g., Production, Development) and delegate policy and access control. ### Naming and Tagging #### Azure Naming Convention | Resource | Abbreviation | Example | |-----------------|-------------|----------------------------| | Subscription | sub | ums-prod-sub | | Resource Group | rg | ums-prod-rg | | Storage Account | st | umsprodst01 | | VM | vm | ums-prod-opdg-vm | #### Fabric Naming Convention | Item in Fabric | Naming | |-----------------|-----------------------------------------------| | Fabric Capacity | stagingareadevcapacity01 | | Workspace | StudentAffairs_dev_WS | | Lakehouse | StudentAffairs_Bronze_LK

Universiti Malaysia Sabah is responsible for operational adherence and cost center assignment. | Resource | Cost Center | Owner | Limit | |--------------------|--------------------|------------------------|-----------------| | Fabric Capacity | Data Analytics | Universiti Malaysia Sabah | As per budget | | Workspace | Student Affairs | Universiti Malaysia Sabah | As per budget | | VM | IT Operations | Universiti Malaysia Sabah | As per budget | ### Violation Triggers and Actions | Trigger | Action | Owner | |-----------------------------------|---------------------------------------|----------------------| | Naming convention violation | Issue remediation ticket | Enfrasys Solutions | | Unauthorized access attempt | Immediate account review and disable | Universiti Malaysia Sabah | | Resource usage exceeding limit | Alert and resource review | Universiti Malaysia Sabah | | Policy non-compliance | Governance review and corrective action| Enfrasys Solutions | # 7.0 Security Design and Decision This section outlines the security architecture and controls recommended for Universiti Malaysia Sabah (UMS), focusing on network protection and encryption for all major workloads. ## 7.1 Azure Network Security Group (NSG) Overview Azure Network Security Groups (NSG) are a fundamental security feature in Microsoft Azure, enabling administrators to filter network traffic to and from Azure resources. NSGs contain rules that allow or deny traffic based on source, destination, port, and protocol. They are critical for enforcing segmentation and minimizing attack surfaces. Enfrasys Solutions shall define and implement NSG rules to ensure secure connectivity for the On-Premises Data Gateway (OPDG) and related services. Universiti Malaysia Sabah shall monitor compliance and report any deviations. ### NSG Rules Table | Name | Priority | Source | Source Ports | Destination | Destination Ports | Protocol | Access | |--------------------------|----------|-----------------------|--------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------------|----------|--------| | Allow_OPDG_HTTPS_Services| 130 | VM Private IP Addresses| * | *.servicebus.windows.net, *.download.microsoft.com, *.core.windows.net, *.frontend.clouddatahub.net, *.dfs.fabric.microsoft.com, *.datawarehouse.fabric.microsoft.com, *.powerbi.com, *.analysis.windows.net | 443 | TCP | Allow | | Allow_OPDG_Authentication| 140 | VM Private IP Addresses| * | *.login.windows.net, login.microsoftonline.com, aadcdn.msauth.net, aadcdn.msftauth.net, *.microsoftonline-p.com, login.live.com | 443 | TCP | Allow | | Allow_OPDG_Connectivity_Test| 160 | VM Private IP Addresses| * | *.msftncsi.com | 80 | TCP | Allow | ![](images\slide_006_img_001.png) Figure 1: Conditional Access and NSG enforcement architecture. ## 7.2 Encryption Design Encryption is a critical component for securing data at rest and in transit within Microsoft workloads. Microsoft Fabric, Power BI, and OPDG leverage Azure-native encryption mechanisms to protect sensitive information. ### Encryption at Rest - **Microsoft Fabric**: Data stored in OneLake and Fabric environments is encrypted at rest using Azure Storage Service Encryption (SSE) with AES-256. - **Power BI**: Datasets and reports are encrypted at rest using Azure-managed keys. - **OPDG**: Data cached or stored on OPDG VMs utilizes Azure Disk Encryption. ### Encryption in Transit - **Microsoft Fabric & Power BI**: All client and service communications occur over HTTPS (TLS 1.2 or higher), ensuring data is encrypted during transmission. - **OPDG**: Outbound connections to Microsoft cloud endpoints use SSL/TLS, protecting authentication and data transfer. Enfrasys Solutions shall configure all encryption settings for the above workloads. Universiti Malaysia Sabah shall monitor ongoing compliance and audit encryption status. ## 7.3 Access Design (Conditional Access and MFA) Microsoft Entra ID is Microsoft's cloud-based identity and access management service, providing authentication, authorization, and security controls for Azure and Microsoft 365 resources. Conditional Access is a feature within Entra ID that allows organizations to enforce access policies based on user, location, device, and risk signals. Based on current licensing, Universiti Malaysia Sabah is not eligible for Conditional Access policies. Therefore, Enfrasys Solutions recommends enforcing Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) at the tenant level for all UMS users to mitigate unauthorized access risks. ![](images\slide_006_img_002.png) Figure 2: Authentication and access control workflow for Microsoft Fabric. ### Access Decisions Table | No. | Policy | Decision | |-----|-----------------------------------------------------|-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------| | DD01| Configure Policy in Conditional Access to include Power BI Service, Azure Data Explorer, Azure SQL Database, and Azure Storage | Deferred (pending license upgrade; enforce MFA at tenant level) | | DD02| Include UMS user inside Conditional Access policy | Deferred (pending license upgrade; enforce MFA at tenant level) | | DD03| UMS users go through additional verification, MFA | Enforce MFA for all UMS users | | DD04| Users able to access Microsoft Fabric’s environment | Permit access with MFA enforcement | ## slides.title: Azure Outbound Security Rules Consideration
slides.notes:
defines the outbound network rules required to allow the On-Premises Data Gateway (OPDG) virtual machine (VM) to securely connect to Microsoft Fabric, Power BI, and related Microsoft cloud services. These rules ensure that the gateway can authenticate, communicate, and transfer data through HTTPS in compliance with Azure networking best practices.

Rule Name : Allow_OPDG_HTTPS_Services
Purpose: Enables HTTPS communication from the gateway VM to Microsoft Fabric and Power BI endpoints.
Explanation: This rule allows outbound TCP traffic on port 443 (HTTPS) from VM Private IP Addresses to essential Microsoft domains, including Fabric, Power BI, and Azure core services (e.g., *.fabric.microsoft.com, *.powerbi.com). It ensures that the gateway can send and receive data securely using SSL/TLS encryption.

Rule Name: Allow_OPDG_Authentication
Purpose: Enables authentication and identity verification with Microsoft Entra ID (formerly Azure AD).
Explanation: This rule allows outbound HTTPS traffic (TCP port 443) to identity and login domains such as login.microsoftonline.com, aadcdn.msftauth.net, and login.windows.net. It enables user sign-ins, token validation, and secure connection establishment with Microsoft cloud services.

Rule Name: Allow_OPDG_Connectivity_Test
Purpose: Supports network connectivity verification for the OPDG service.
Explanation: This rule allows outbound HTTP traffic on port 80 (TCP) to *.msftncsi.com, a Microsoft endpoint used for network connectivity status indication and troubleshooting. It ensures the VM can verify external internet access and service availability.

# UMS Power BI & Fabric Design Review # 2.0 Executive Summary This section provides a concise overview of the project context, document purpose, and target audience for the Universiti Malaysia Sabah (UMS) Power BI & Fabric Solution Design. ## 2.1 Project Overview Universiti Malaysia Sabah (UMS) has commissioned Enfrasys Solutions to architect a comprehensive data workflow leveraging Microsoft Fabric. The project scope encompasses the design and implementation of a Fabric workspace, development of an end-to-end ETL pipeline, integration of Machine Learning processes, and deployment of Power BI for business-aligned analytics. Key objectives include aligning UMS’s cloud adoption strategy with Microsoft Fabric’s capabilities—specifically, Fabric Data Factory for data integration and orchestration, Fabric Synapse for advanced analytics and big data processing, and Data Science for machine learning applications. ## 2.2 Document Purpose The purpose of this Solution Design Document is to formally capture the technical architecture, design decisions, and implementation guidance for the UMS Power BI & Fabric deployment. This document will serve as the authoritative reference for solution review, stakeholder sign-off, and as the implementation blueprint for both UMS and Enfrasys Solutions teams. ## 2.3 Document Audience The intended audience for this document includes: - UMS IT Department - UMS Data Analytics Team - Enfrasys Solutions Implementation Team - UMS Project Sponsors and Stakeholders Enfrasys Solutions is responsible for drafting this document. Universiti Malaysia Sabah (UMS) is responsible for review and sign-off. # 3.0 Microsoft Fabric, Power BI, and Entra ID Overview This section provides formal definitions and roles of Microsoft Fabric, Power BI, and Microsoft Entra ID in the Universiti Malaysia Sabah (UMS) solution. Enfrasys Solutions is responsible for technology explanation; UMS shall validate alignment with business requirements. ## 3.1 Microsoft Fabric Microsoft Fabric is an integrated analytics platform that unifies data engineering, data science, and business intelligence capabilities within a single SaaS environment. It provides organizations with a comprehensive suite of services for data ingestion, transformation, storage, analytics, and visualization. Fabric core services include: - **Data Factory**: Enables data integration and orchestration, supporting ETL (Extract, Transform, Load) pipelines to connect disparate data sources and automate data movement. - **Synapse**: Offers advanced analytics and big data processing, combining enterprise data warehousing, big data analytics, and real-time data processing. - **Data Science**: Facilitates machine learning and AI model development, training, and deployment, supporting predictive analytics and advanced data science workflows. In the UMS solution, Microsoft Fabric will serve as the central platform for end-to-end data workflow—from ingestion through transformation and analytics—supporting business-aligned use cases and integration with visualization tools. ## 3.2 Power BI Power BI is a Microsoft business analytics service designed to deliver interactive visualizations and business intelligence capabilities with an interface simple enough for end users to create their own reports and dashboards. Power BI integrates natively with Microsoft Fabric, leveraging its unified data platform to provide real-time analytics, data exploration, and reporting. Within the UMS solution, Power BI will be used to visualize transformed data from Fabric, enabling actionable insights, performance monitoring, and decision support for stakeholders. The integration ensures seamless access to curated datasets, robust security, and scalable analytics. ## 3.3 Microsoft Entra ID Microsoft Entra ID (formerly Azure Active Directory) is a cloud-based identity and access management service. It provides secure authentication, authorization, and conditional access for users, applications, and devices. Entra ID enables organizations to manage user identities, enforce multi-factor authentication (MFA), and implement security policies to protect resources. Communication between the On-Premises Data Gateway VM and Microsoft cloud services occurs exclusively over HTTPS (TCP port 443), leveraging strong encryption standards. # SIRIM Analytics Deployment

# 2.0 Executive Summary

This section provides a concise overview of the SIRIM Analytics Deployment project, the purpose of this Solution Design Document, and its intended audience.

## 2.1 Project Overview

The SIRIM Analytics Deployment project is commissioned by SIRIM Berhad to modernize and optimize the organization's Human Resource data workflows. The primary business drivers include enhancing data integration, transformation, and visualization capabilities to support strategic HR decision-making. The project scope encompasses the design and implementation of end-to-end data workflows, leveraging Microsoft Fabric services such as Fabric Data Factory for data integration and orchestration, and Fabric Synapse for advanced analytics and big data processing. The deployment aligns with SIRIM Berhad’s cloud adoption strategy, ensuring scalable, secure, and efficient analytics infrastructure.

**Microsoft Fabric Definition:**  
Microsoft Fabric is a unified analytics platform that integrates data engineering, data science, real-time analytics, and business intelligence into a single SaaS solution. It provides services such as Data Factory for data integration, Synapse for big data analytics, and Power BI for visualization, enabling organizations to streamline data workflows and accelerate insights.

## 2.2 Document Purpose

The purpose of this Solution Design Document is to formally capture the architectural decisions, technical specifications, and implementation roadmap for the SIRIM Analytics Deployment. It serves as a foundational reference throughout the project lifecycle, guiding stakeholders on infrastructure design, data workflow, security, access control, and migration activities. Enfrasys Solutions is responsible for the authorship and technical accuracy of this document, while SIRIM Berhad is responsible for its review and approval.

**Solution Design Document Definition:**  
A Solution Design Document is a comprehensive artifact that details the technical architecture, design decisions, and implementation plan for a project. It ensures alignment among stakeholders, facilitates quality assurance, and provides a baseline for future maintenance and enhancements.

## 2.3 Document Audience

The intended audience for this Solution Design Document includes:

- SIRIM Berhad IT Department
- SIRIM Berhad Human Resource Department
- Enfrasys Solutions Architects
- SIRIM Berhad Project Management Office
- Enfrasys Solutions Project Delivery Team

Enfrasys Solutions is assigned responsibility for document authorship, while SIRIM Berhad shall review and approve the document to ensure it meets organizational requirements.

**Audience Definition:**  
The document audience comprises all stakeholders involved in the design, implementation, review, and governance of the SIRIM Analytics Deployment. This includes technical teams, business users, and project managers who require clear visibility into the solution architecture and execution plan.

# 3.0 Microsoft Fabric Analytics Overview

This section provides an overview of Microsoft Fabric, its core analytics services, and supporting technologies relevant to SIRIM Berhad’s Human Resource data workflow.

## 3.1 Microsoft Fabric: Definition and Core Services

Microsoft Fabric is a unified analytics platform that integrates multiple Microsoft data and analytics services into a single, SaaS-based environment. Fabric provides end-to-end capabilities for data ingestion, transformation, storage, analytics, and visualization, enabling organizations to streamline their data workflows and accelerate insights.

Core services within Microsoft Fabric include:

- **Data Factory**: Data Factory is Fabric’s data integration and orchestration service, enabling the ingestion, movement, and transformation of data from diverse sources into centralized storage.
- **Synapse**: Synapse is Fabric’s advanced analytics engine, supporting big data processing, complex transformations, and machine learning workloads.
- **Power BI**: Power BI is Fabric’s visualization and reporting service, offering interactive dashboards and business intelligence capabilities directly integrated with Fabric’s data storage.
- **OneLake**: OneLake is Fabric’s unified data lake storage, providing a single repository for all data, accessible by all Fabric services.

Enfrasys Solutions is responsible for enabling and configuring these services for SIRIM Berhad’s analytics environment.

### Core Features Summary Table

| Capability         | Description                                                                                 |
|--------------------|---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| Data Factory       | Data ingestion, ETL, orchestration of pipelines                                             |
| Synapse            | Advanced analytics, big data processing, machine learning                                   |
| Power BI           | Visualization, dashboarding, semantic modeling, row-level security                          |
| OneLake            | Unified storage, multi-layered Lakehouse architecture (Bronze, Silver, Gold)                |

## 3.2 Microsoft Entra ID (Azure Active Directory): Definition and Role

Microsoft Entra ID (formerly Azure Active Directory) is a cloud-based identity and access management service. Entra ID provides secure authentication, authorization, and user management for Microsoft Fabric and other Microsoft cloud services. It ensures that only authorized SIRIM Berhad personnel can access data, analytics, and reporting resources, and supports granular role-based access control.

Enfrasys Solutions is responsible for integrating Entra ID with Fabric and configuring access policies for SIRIM Berhad.

### Core Features Summary Table

| Capability         | Description                                                                                 |
|--------------------|---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| Authentication     | Secure user sign-in, multi-factor authentication                                            |
| Authorization      | Role-based access control, group management                                                 |
| Integration        | Seamless connection to Microsoft Fabric, Power BI, and other Microsoft 365 services         |
| Security           | Conditional access, audit logs, identity protection                                         |

## 3.3 Microsoft 365 Integration with Microsoft Fabric

Microsoft 365 integration enables seamless collaboration and productivity enhancements within Microsoft Fabric. By connecting Fabric services to Microsoft 365 (including Teams, SharePoint, and Outlook), SIRIM Berhad can leverage familiar productivity tools for sharing insights, automating workflows, and embedding analytics into daily operations.

Enfrasys Solutions is responsible for enabling Microsoft 365 integration and ensuring that SIRIM Berhad’s users can access and share Fabric analytics securely.

### Core Features Summary Table

| Capability         | Description                                                                                 |
|--------------------|---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| Teams Integration  | Share Power BI reports, collaborate on analytics in Teams                                   |
| SharePoint         | Embed dashboards and reports within SharePoint sites                                        |
| Outlook            | Distribute insights via email, schedule report delivery                                     |
| Productivity       | Streamlined workflow between analytics and business operations                              |

## 3.4 Data Workflow Architecture

![](images\slide_016_img_004.png)

Figure 1: End-to-end data workflow architecture for SIRIM Berhad.

## 3.5 Data Workflow Design Considerations

| ID    | Description                                                                                              | Workload Type    |

| DC01  | Data Pipeline will be used to ingest data from PostgreSQL.                                               | Data Factory     |
| DC02  | The bronze Lakehouse will store raw/original data ingested from PostgreSQL.                              | Data Engineering |
| DC03  | The silver Lakehouse will store cleansed data sourced from the bronze Lakehouse.                         | Data Engineering |
| DC04  | The gold Lakehouse will store transformed data sourced from the silver Lakehouse.                        | Data Engineering |
| DC05  | Data cleansing and transformation for the bronze and silver Lakehouse will be performed using Visual Query in the SQL Analytics Endpoint. | Data Engineering |
| DC06  | Dataflow Gen2 will be used to move data between Lakehouses (e.g., from bronze to silver or silver to gold). | Data Factory     |
| DC07  | Data modeling and row-level security (RLS) configurations will be implemented in the Semantic Model, using data from the gold Lakehouse. | Power BI         |
| DC08  | Power BI Desktop will connect to the Semantic Model via OneLake for data visualization.                  | Power BI         |

| Microsoft Fabric Enablement  | Provision, configure, and integrate Fabric services         | Enfrasys Solutions| Pending  |

# 4.0 Network Design and Decision

This section outlines the network architecture and connectivity decisions for SIRIM Berhad’s Azure-based Fabric solution, including connectivity, security, and gateway placement.

## 4.1 Network Connectivity Overview

Azure Virtual Network (VNet) is a fundamental networking resource in Microsoft Azure, providing secure, isolated environments for deploying Azure resources. VNet peering enables seamless connectivity between VNets, while Site-to-Site (S2S) VPN establishes secure connections between on-premises networks and Azure. Windows Virtual Desktop (WVD) provides remote desktop access to Azure-hosted resources.

SIRIM Berhad’s network topology incorporates multiple Azure VNets, VNet peering, S2S VPN, and WVD to ensure secure and scalable connectivity between on-premises infrastructure, external users, and Azure Fabric resources.

![](images\slide_012_img_003.png)

Figure 1: Azure network topology with S2S VPN, VNet peering, and WVD integration.

### Network Component Summary

| Network Component       | Purpose                                                | Connectivity Type           |
|------------------------|--------------------------------------------------------|-----------------------------|
| Azure VNet 1           | Hosts Virtual Network Gateway for S2S VPN              | S2S VPN, VNet Peering       |
| Azure VNet 2           | Hosts Windows Virtual Desktop (WVD)                    | VNet Peering                |
| Fabric-VNet            | Hosts Fabric resources and Private Endpoint            | VNet Peering, Private Link  |
| Virtual Network Gateway| Enables S2S VPN to SIRIM on-premises network           | S2S VPN                     |
| WVD                    | Provides secure remote access for external users       | VNet Peering                |
| Private Endpoint       | Secures Fabric access within Azure internal network    | Private Link                |

#### Design Decisions

| No. | Design Decision                                                                 | Decision                                  |
|-----|---------------------------------------------------------------------------------|-------------------------------------------|
| 1   | Use Azure VNets with peering for internal service communication                 | Implemented                               |
| 2   | Establish S2S VPN between SIRIM on-premises and Azure                          | Implemented                               |
| 3   | Deploy WVD in a separate VNet for external user access                         | Implemented                               |
| 4   | Use Private Endpoint for Fabric workspace access                                | Implemented (with limitations)            |
| 5   | Restrict Fabric access to internal network only                                 | Enforced via NSG and Private Endpoint     |

#### Task/Migration Rollout

| Item                  | Activities                                                                                  | Action By         | Status      |
|-----------------------|--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|-------------------|-------------|
| VNet Configuration    | Create and peer VNets for Fabric, WVD, and Gateway                                         | Enfrasys Solutions| Pending     |
| S2S VPN Setup         | Configure Virtual Network Gateway and establish VPN with on-premises SIRIM network         | SIRIM Berhad      | Pending     |
| WVD Deployment        | Deploy Windows Virtual Desktop in dedicated VNet                                           | Enfrasys Solutions| Pending     |
| NSG Implementation    | Configure NSG rules for WVD and Fabric access                                              | Enfrasys Solutions| Pending     |
| Private Endpoint Setup| Deploy Private Endpoint for Fabric workspace                                               | Enfrasys Solutions| Pending     |

## 4.2 Fabric Data Gateway

Microsoft Data Gateway is a secure bridge facilitating data transfer between on-premises data sources and Azure services such as Microsoft Fabric. It is typically deployed on a dedicated VM within the Azure environment to ensure secure and reliable connectivity.

SIRIM Berhad shall implement a Data Gateway VM within the designated resource group, ensuring it is properly placed to bridge data between TOPAZ (PostgreSQL) and SIRIM Fabric. Enfrasys Solutions is responsible for the VM design and deployment, while SIRIM Berhad is responsible for ensuring network prerequisites, including necessary firewall and connectivity settings.

# 5.0 Roles in Microsoft Fabric

This section defines the roles, permissions, and responsibilities within Microsoft Fabric for SIRIM Berhad’s analytics deployment.

## 5.1 Fabric Administrator Role

Microsoft Fabric is an integrated analytics platform that unifies data engineering, data science, real-time analytics, and business intelligence under a single SaaS solution. It provides centralized management, governance, and access control for all analytics workloads.

The Fabric Administrator is responsible for overseeing the entire Microsoft Fabric environment, ensuring proper governance, security, and operational continuity. Administrators have the highest level of permissions and can manage all aspects of the platform, including user access, workspace creation, content lifecycle, and security policies.

### Fabric Administrator Responsibilities and Permissions

- Manage workspace creation, deletion, and configuration.
- Assign and revoke roles and permissions for users and groups.
- Oversee content publishing, editing, and deletion across workspaces.
- Configure and enforce security policies, including row-level security (RLS).
- Monitor platform usage, audit activities, and ensure compliance.
- Integrate Microsoft Fabric with external systems (e.g., OneLake, Power BI, Data Factory).
- Troubleshoot and resolve platform issues.

Enfrasys Solutions is responsible for designing the administrator role structure. SIRIM Berhad shall assign personnel to the Fabric Administrator role.

## 5.2 Fabric-native Roles

Microsoft Fabric provides several native roles to control access and actions within workspaces and analytics components. Each role is tailored to specific responsibilities and typical assignees.

| Role Name      | Permissions                                                                                      | Typical Assignee           |
|----------------|--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|----------------------------|
| Admin          | Full control: manage roles, permissions, publish/edit/delete content, workspace settings         | IT Leads, Data Engineers   |
| Contributor    | Create/edit/delete own content, cannot delete others’ content or change workspace settings       | Business Users, Data Engineers |
| Member         | Create/edit/delete reports, pipelines, share content, cannot manage roles/permissions            | Data Engineers, Analysts   |
| Viewer         | View all content, cannot modify or publish content                                               | Business Users, Executives |
| Data Engineer  | Design, build, and manage data pipelines, lakehouses, and transformations                        | Data Engineering Team      |
| Data Analyst   | Build and analyze reports, dashboards, configure semantic models, implement row-level security   | Analytics Team             |

Enfrasys Solutions is responsible for defining the role structure. SIRIM Berhad shall assign personnel to each role.

## 5.3 SIRIM Workspace Role and Access

The following table maps SIRIM Berhad personnel to workspace roles based on operational requirements and suggested assignments. Enfrasys Solutions will design the role mapping, while SIRIM Berhad is responsible for assigning personnel.

| No. | Workspace Role                                                                 | Suggested Role                  | SIRIM PIC                  |
|-----|--------------------------------------------------------------------------------|----------------------------------|----------------------------|
| 1   | Workspace Admin: add/remove users, manage roles and permissions, publish/edit/delete content | Fabric Admin/Data Engineer       | En Wazir<br>Puan Solehah   |
| 2   | Workspace Contributor: create/edit/delete own content, cannot delete others’ content or change settings | Data Engineer / Business User Admin | Aina<br>Khairul<br>Puan Solehah |
| 3   | Workspace Viewer: view report/dashboard, cannot edit/publish content            | Data Analyst                    | Aina<br>Khairul<br>Puan Solehah |
| 4   | Workspace Member: create/edit/delete reports, pipelines, share content, cannot manage roles/permissions | Data Engineer                   | Aina<br>Khairul<br>Puan Solehah |

Enfrasys Solutions recommends that SIRIM Berhad establish clear role assignments and maintain regular reviews to ensure compliance and operational efficiency.

| DC08 | Power BI Desktop will connect to the Semantic Model via OneLake for data visualization.                         | Power BI          |

## 6.2 Data Workflow Design Decisions

SIRIM Berhad shall implement a multi-layered data workflow leveraging Microsoft Fabric’s Lakehouse architecture. Data is ingested from PostgreSQL via Data Factory pipelines, stored in bronze, silver, and gold Lakehouse layers, and processed using SQL Analytics Endpoints and Dataflow Gen2. Semantic Models are defined for reporting, with row-level security enforced for HR data access.

![](images\slide_016_img_004.png)

Figure 1: End-to-end data workflow architecture.

| No. | Design Decision                                                                                                      | Decision                                                                                   |
|-----|----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| 1   | Data ingestion via Data Factory from PostgreSQL                                                                      | Approved; ensures scalable, automated data pipeline                                        |
| 2   | Multi-layer Lakehouse (bronze, silver, gold) for progressive data refinement                                         | Approved; supports modular data engineering and analytics                                  |
| 3   | Data cleansing via Visual Query in SQL Analytics Endpoint                                                            | Approved; enables interactive, auditable transformation                                    |
| 4   | Dataflow Gen2 for movement between Lakehouse layers                                                                  | Approved; automates data orchestration                                                     |
| 5   | Semantic Model for reporting and row-level security                                                                  | Approved; enforces access control and business logic                                       |
| 6   | Power BI Desktop connection via OneLake                                                                              | Approved; provides unified analytics and visualization                                     |

## 6.3 Access Design Considerations and Decisions

### 6.3.1 Conditional Access

Conditional Access is a Microsoft Entra ID feature that allows organizations to enforce security policies based on user, location, device, and application context. It is essential for protecting sensitive analytics workloads in Fabric.

| Option                          | Pros                                                                                              | Cons                                                      | Decision  | Rationale                                                                                      |
|----------------------------------|---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|-----------------------------------------------------------|-----------|-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| Configure Policy for Power BI, Azure Data Explorer, Azure SQL Database, Azure Storage | Centralizes security, granular control, integrates with SIRIM’s Entra ID                        | Requires policy tuning, may impact user experience         | Approved  | Ensures only authorized SIRIM users access analytics workloads                                  |
| Include SIRIM user inside Conditional Access policy          | Tailored access for SIRIM personnel, supports HR group mapping                                  | Requires accurate group management                        | Approved  | Enforces least privilege and role-based access                                                  |
| Configure NSG in SIRIM’s WVD for Fabric inbound/outbound     | Network-level control, limits exposure                                                          | Adds administrative overhead                              | Approved  | Augments Conditional Access with network boundaries                                             |

### 6.3.2 Private Endpoint

Private Endpoint is an Azure networking feature that enables secure, private connectivity to Azure services, eliminating public exposure.

| Option                           | Pros                                                                                              | Cons                                                      | Decision  | Rationale                                                                                      |
|-----------------------------------|---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|-----------------------------------------------------------|-----------|-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| Enable Private Link in Fabric     | Eliminates public access, enhances data security                                                  | Requires Azure networking setup                           | Approved  | Protects sensitive HR and analytics data from external threats                                  |
| Create Private Endpoint in Azure portal | Simplifies deployment, integrates with SIRIM’s resource groups                                  | Needs ongoing monitoring                                  | Approved  | Ensures secure access for internal analytics workloads                                          |
| Disable Public Access from Fabric | Maximum security, prevents accidental exposure                                                    | May require additional troubleshooting for connectivity   | Approved  | Aligns with SIRIM Berhad’s data governance and compliance requirements                          |

# 7.0 Security Design and Decision

This section details the security architecture for SIRIM Berhad's Azure-based solution, including network security group (NSG) rules, encryption design, and access control mechanisms.

## 7.1 Azure Network Security Group (NSG) Overview

Azure Network Security Groups (NSGs) are fundamental components of Azure networking, providing granular control over inbound and outbound traffic to Azure resources. NSGs use rules to permit or deny traffic based on source, destination, port, and protocol, ensuring that only authorized communications occur within the cloud environment.

Enfrasys Solutions is responsible for the design and implementation of NSG rules. SIRIM Berhad shall enforce and maintain security policies in accordance with organizational requirements.

### Inbound NSG Rules

| Name                | Priority | Source       | Source Ports | Destination         | Destination Ports | Protocol | Access |
|---------------------|----------|--------------|--------------|---------------------|-------------------|----------|--------|
| Allow_Fabric_Inbound| 110      | Service Tag  | 443          | Vm Private IP Addresses | *             | TCP      | Allow  |

### Outbound NSG Rules

| Name                | Priority | Source                | Source Ports | Destination   | Destination Ports | Protocol | Access |
|---------------------|----------|-----------------------|--------------|---------------|-------------------|----------|--------|
| Allow_Fabric_Outbound| 110     | Vm Private IP Addresses| *           | Service Tag   | 443               | TCP      | Allow  |

## 7.2 Encryption Design

Encryption is a critical element of the security posture for SIRIM Berhad, ensuring data confidentiality and integrity during storage and transmission.

### Encryption at Rest

Microsoft Azure provides built-in encryption at rest for all managed storage resources, including Azure SQL Database, Azure Storage, and Azure Data Explorer. Data is encrypted using industry-standard algorithms such as AES-256. Enfrasys Solutions recommends leveraging Azure's default encryption mechanisms, with SIRIM Berhad responsible for monitoring compliance and enforcing encryption policies.

### Encryption in Transit

Data in transit between users, services, and Azure resources is protected using TLS 1.2 or higher. All communications to Power BI Service, Azure Data Explorer, Azure SQL Database, and Azure Storage are secured by default. Enfrasys Solutions will configure secure endpoints and enforce the use of encrypted protocols. SIRIM Berhad shall ensure user devices and applications comply with secure access requirements.

## 7.3 Access Design (Conditional Access)

Conditional Access is a feature of Microsoft Entra ID (formerly Azure Active Directory) that allows organizations to enforce access controls based on user identity, device compliance, location, and other factors. It enables secure, adaptive authentication for cloud resources.

Enfrasys Solutions will design Conditional Access policies targeting Power BI Service, Azure Data Explorer, Azure SQL Database, and Azure Storage. SIRIM Berhad shall implement and maintain these policies, including secure login, multi-factor authentication (MFA), and extra checks for SIRIM users. External users will access resources indirectly via Windows Virtual Desktop (WVD), with access managed through NSG rules.

| Conditional Access Setup| Design Conditional Access policies for Power BI, Azure Data Explorer, SQL DB, Azure Storage| Enfrasys Solutions  | Pending  |
| Policy Enforcement      | Enforce security policies, monitor compliance, manage user access                          | SIRIM Berhad        | Pending  |

slides.notes:
defines the outbound network rules required to allow the On-Premises Data Gateway (OPDG) virtual machine (VM) to securely connect to Microsoft Fabric, Power BI, and related Microsoft cloud services. These rules ensure that the gateway can authenticate, communicate, and transfer data through HTTPS in compliance with Azure networking best practices.

Rule Name : Allow_OPDG_HTTPS_Services
Purpose: Enables HTTPS communication from the gateway VM to Microsoft Fabric and Power BI endpoints.
Explanation: This rule allows outbound TCP traffic on port 443 (HTTPS) from VM Private IP Addresses to essential Microsoft domains, including Fabric, Power BI, and Azure core services (e.g., *.fabric.microsoft.com, *.powerbi.com). It ensures that the gateway can send and receive data securely using SSL/TLS encryption.

Rule Name: Allow_OPDG_Authentication
Purpose: Enables authentication and identity verification with Microsoft Entra ID (formerly Azure AD).
Explanation: This rule allows outbound HTTPS traffic (TCP port 443) to identity and login domains such as login.microsoftonline.com, aadcdn.msftauth.net, and login.windows.net. It enables user sign-ins, token validation, and secure connection establishment with Microsoft cloud services.

Rule Name: Allow_OPDG_Connectivity_Test
Purpose: Supports network connectivity verification for the OPDG service.
Explanation: This rule allows outbound HTTP traffic on port 80 (TCP) to *.msftncsi.com, a Microsoft endpoint used for network connectivity status indication and troubleshooting. It ensures the VM can verify external internet access and service availability.

# UMS Power BI & Fabric Design Review

# 2.0 Executive Summary

This section provides a concise overview of the project context, document purpose, and intended audience for the Universiti Malaysia Sabah (UMS) Power BI & Microsoft Fabric solution design.

## 2.1 Project Overview

Microsoft Fabric is an integrated analytics platform that unifies data engineering, data science, real-time analytics, and business intelligence within a single SaaS environment. It includes services such as Data Factory for data integration and orchestration, Synapse for advanced analytics and big data processing, and Data Science for machine learning applications.

The business context for Universiti Malaysia Sabah (UMS) centers on the modernization of data workflows to support business-aligned analytics. The scope of this project is to design the data workflow from ingestion through transformation and visualization using Microsoft Fabric. Key objectives include:
- Establishing a dedicated Fabric workspace for UMS.
- Developing an end-to-end ETL pipeline to streamline data ingestion and transformation.
- Conducting machine learning processes for advanced analytics.
- Integrating Power BI to deliver actionable business insights.

This design aligns UMS’s cloud adoption strategy with the capabilities of Microsoft Fabric, ensuring scalable, secure, and efficient analytics operations.

## 2.2 Document Purpose

The Solution Design Document serves as the authoritative reference for the proposed Microsoft Fabric and Power BI implementation at UMS. Its primary purpose is to:

# 3.0 Microsoft Fabric, Power BI & Entra ID Overview

This section provides an overview of the core Microsoft technologies forming the foundation of Universiti Malaysia Sabah's (UMS) data analytics solution, including Microsoft Fabric, Power BI, and Microsoft Entra ID.

## 3.1 Microsoft Fabric Overview

Microsoft Fabric is a unified analytics platform designed to empower organizations with end-to-end data management, integration, analytics, and machine learning capabilities. Fabric consolidates multiple data services into a single SaaS offering, enabling seamless data workflows from ingestion to visualization. Its core services include:

- **Data Factory**: Provides robust data integration and orchestration, allowing organizations to ingest, transform, and move data across diverse sources.
- **Synapse**: Delivers advanced analytics and big data processing, supporting complex data exploration, warehousing, and real-time analytics.
- **Data Science**: Enables machine learning and AI-driven applications, offering tools for data scientists to build, train, and deploy models.
- **OneLake**: Acts as a unified data lake, centralizing storage for all data workloads within Fabric.

Enfrasys Solutions recommends Microsoft Fabric for UMS to establish a scalable, secure, and integrated analytics environment. The platform will serve as the backbone for data ingestion, transformation, machine learning, and visualization workflows.

## 3.2 Power BI Overview

Power BI is Microsoft's business intelligence and analytics platform that enables users to visualize data, generate insights, and share reports across the organization. Power BI integrates natively with Microsoft Fabric, allowing seamless access to data stored in OneLake and processed through Data Factory and Synapse. This integration streamlines the creation of dashboards and analytics aligned with UMS's business requirements.

Enfrasys Solutions is responsible for the technology selection and integration of Power BI with Fabric. Universiti Malaysia Sabah shall implement user enablement for Power BI, ensuring personnel are trained and authorized to utilize analytics and reporting capabilities.

## 3.3 Microsoft Entra ID Overview

Microsoft Entra ID (formerly Azure Active Directory) is a comprehensive cloud-based identity and access management solution. Entra ID provides authentication, authorization, and conditional access controls for users, applications, and resources in the Microsoft ecosystem. Key features include:

- Single sign-on (SSO) for seamless access to cloud and on-premises applications.
- Multi-factor authentication (MFA) to enhance security.
- Conditional Access policies for granular control over resource access based on user, location, device, and risk signals.

Enfrasys Solutions is responsible for configuring Entra ID and Conditional Access policies. Universiti Malaysia Sabah shall enable users and maintain account hygiene, ensuring compliance with enforced MFA and access requirements.

# 7.0 Security Design and Decision

This section outlines the security architecture for Universiti Malaysia Sabah (UMS), focusing on Azure Network Security Group (NSG) configuration and encryption practices for Microsoft Fabric and Power BI workloads.

## 7.1 Azure NSG Overview

Azure Network Security Groups (NSGs) are a core Microsoft Azure security feature that enables granular control of inbound and outbound network traffic to Azure resources. NSGs use rules to allow or deny traffic based on source, destination, port, and protocol. NSGs are critical for enforcing least privilege and protecting cloud workloads against unauthorized access.

Enfrasys Solutions is responsible for designing, implementing, and validating NSG rules. Universiti Malaysia Sabah (UMS) shall ensure all operational activities adhere to the established security policies and procedures.

The following table summarizes the outbound NSG rules required for secure operation of the On-Premises Data Gateway (OPDG) VM, facilitating connectivity to Microsoft Fabric, Power BI, and related Microsoft cloud services:

| Name                        | Priority | Source                  | Source Ports | Destination                                                                                                                         | Destination Ports | Protocol | Access |
|-----------------------------|----------|-------------------------|--------------|-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|-------------------|----------|--------|
| Allow_OPDG_HTTPS_Services   | 130      | VM Private IP Addresses | *            | *.servicebus.windows.net, *.download.microsoft.com, *.core.windows.net, *.frontend.clouddatahub.net, *.dfs.fabric.microsoft.com, *.datawarehouse.fabric.microsoft.com, *.powerbi.com, *.analysis.windows.net | 443               | TCP      | Allow  |
| Allow_OPDG_Authentication   | 140      | VM Private IP Addresses | *            | *.login.windows.net, login.microsoftonline.com, aadcdn.msauth.net, aadcdn.msftauth.net, *.microsoftonline-p.com, login.live.com      | 443               | TCP      | Allow  |

## 7.2 Encryption Design

Microsoft Fabric and Power BI are enterprise-grade analytics platforms that leverage Azure’s built-in security capabilities to safeguard data. Encryption is a fundamental requirement for protecting sensitive information both at rest and in transit.

### Encryption at Rest

All data stored within Microsoft Fabric, Power BI, and associated Azure services is encrypted at rest using Azure Storage Service Encryption (SSE) with Microsoft-managed keys. This ensures that data residing in storage accounts, data warehouses, and analytic workspaces is protected against unauthorized access. Enfrasys Solutions will configure storage and workspace resources to enforce encryption at rest, following Microsoft best practices.

### Encryption in Transit

Data in transit between the OPDG VM, Microsoft Fabric, Power BI, and identity services is protected using SSL/TLS encryption. Outbound NSG rules restrict traffic to HTTPS (TCP port 443), ensuring that all communications utilize strong cryptographic protocols. Enfrasys Solutions will validate SSL/TLS configurations and endpoint certificates for all gateway and workspace connections.

Universiti Malaysia Sabah (UMS) shall ensure that all users and administrators access the platform via secure channels and comply with organizational security policies regarding data handling and transmission.

## 8.2 Pilot

The pilot phase is intended to validate the deployment in a controlled environment, ensuring all technical and business requirements are met prior to full-scale rollout.

- Enfrasys Solutions will deploy the pilot environment, including configuration of Microsoft Fabric and On-Premises Data Gateway.
- UMS shall provide access to staging data and participate in initial validation.

## 8.3 Production Deployment

The production deployment is structured in formal waves, with clear timelines and responsibilities.

### Deployment Timeline

- **D-7 (7 days prior to cutover):**

- **D0 (Cutover Day):**

- **D+1 (Post-Cutover):**
    - Monitor system health and performance (Enfrasys Solutions).
    - UMS performs full data validation and user acceptance.
    - Address any post-migration issues (Enfrasys Solutions).

## 8.4 Post-Migration / Support

A structured support and handover model ensures operational continuity post-migration.

- Enfrasys Solutions will provide post-migration support for a defined period, including troubleshooting, performance monitoring, and minor adjustments.
- UMS shall conduct acceptance testing, report issues, and confirm operational readiness.
- Formal handover documentation and knowledge transfer sessions will be provided by Enfrasys Solutions to UMS IT personnel.

slides.title: Azure Outbound Security Rules Consideration
slides.notes:
defines the outbound network rules required to allow the On-Premises Data Gateway (OPDG) virtual machine (VM) to securely connect to Microsoft Fabric, Power BI, and related Microsoft cloud services. These rules ensure that the gateway can authenticate, communicate, and transfer data through HTTPS in compliance with Azure networking best practices.

Rule Name : Allow_OPDG_HTTPS_Services
Purpose: Enables HTTPS communication from the gateway VM to Microsoft Fabric and Power BI endpoints.
Explanation: This rule allows outbound TCP traffic on port 443 (HTTPS) from VM Private IP Addresses to essential Microsoft domains, including Fabric, Power BI, and Azure core services (e.g., *.fabric.microsoft.com, *.powerbi.com). It ensures that the gateway can send and receive data securely using SSL/TLS encryption.

Rule Name: Allow_OPDG_Authentication
Purpose: Enables authentication and identity verification with Microsoft Entra ID (formerly Azure AD).
Explanation: This rule allows outbound HTTPS traffic (TCP port 443) to identity and login domains such as login.microsoftonline.com, aadcdn.msftauth.net, and login.windows.net. It enables user sign-ins, token validation, and secure connection establishment with Microsoft cloud services.

Rule Name: Allow_OPDG_Connectivity_Test
Purpose: Supports network connectivity verification for the OPDG service.
Explanation: This rule allows outbound HTTP traffic on port 80 (TCP) to *.msftncsi.com, a Microsoft endpoint used for network connectivity status indication and troubleshooting. It ensures the VM can verify external internet access and service availability.
